package.name: bfmc_ui_server
package.description: Race-day static-file HTTP server for the BFMC big-screen dashboard. Serves the legacy Bosch React build (Bfmc_userinterface/dist/) plus a companion dashboard.html that consumes /ui/status. Pure C++ / POSIX sockets, no external deps. The browser then talks to rosbridge_server on ws://<host>:9090 directly.
